text:
Olivia: Quick idea from growth — run a 'Prompt Jam' mini-event tied to product-led onboarding. attendees get a 150-credit bundle if they complete a 3-step quickstart (import template, run sample prompt, save a prompt). goal = shorten time-to-first-success and increase 3-day activation. agree to test?

Ben: Sounds good. 150 credits instead of 200 keeps cost down and still feels meaningful. we should gate on 'save a prompt' not just run. saves people who just click. :white_check_mark:

Jordan: Agree on gating. UX ask: one-click import button that auto-populates a new prompt in the user's workspace and shows a success toast. DevEx can instrument the save event.

Priya: Measurement notes: primary = % users with >=500 tokens within 3 days. secondary = prompt reuse rate at 7 days. cohort tag = promptjam_150_apr2026. tracking events: marketing.promptjam_claim, prompt.saved, prompt.ran.

Kim: Messaging test: Variant 1 = "Get 150 credits by finishing our 5-min Prompt Jam"; Variant 2 = "Ship your first prompt — unlock 150 credits"; Variant 3 = internal holdback control. Run only 2 live variants + control.

Nate: Routing: route visitors from community partners to partner_cohort but enroll in same experiment bucket. also ensure email registrants get the same assignment. randomize at registration endpoint.

Olivia: Audience: new signups in last 45 days + previously inactive trialers. we can also push to webinar registrants. expected fill rate ~1.2k over 3 weeks.

Priya: Power calc: baseline 3-day activation 9%. to detect +4ppt with 80% power need ~1.5k per arm. with 3 arms that's ~4.5k total. if we can't hit that, we'll collapse to 2 arms.

Ben: Ops constraints: we need idempotent grant endpoint and rate-limits handled. prefer a single server-side grant call when the user completes the save action. include reason=\"promptjam_apr2026\" in logs.

Jordan: Dev checklist: one-click import component, hook on prompt.save event, server endpoint to grant credits, experiment flag check, UI confirmation modal with credit balance.

Kim: Copy + landing: I'll draft hero copy + three short CTAs. call out "no card" and "instant credits". also add small FAQ: "how credits expire".

Priya: Analytics: I'll create a dashboard with daily funnel (visited -> registered -> completed quickstart -> claimed -> 3-day activated). will surface breakdown by source and variant.

Nate: For partner routing, add query param ?partner=NAME and set source property. also mark partner visits so we can measure lift separately.

Olivia: Example snippet we can give Eng for the grant call:
```js
await fetch('/api/v1/credits/grant', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ user_id, amount: 150, reason: 'promptjam_apr2026' })
});
```

Ben: Testing: run internal beta with staff first, confirm metrics flow, then soft-launch to a subset of community. monitor for abuse (multiple accounts).

Jordan: I'll add a replayable telemetry event and include request_id in grant response for traceability.

Priya: Add an eval set to monitor prompt quality from workshop templates. promptset id = promptjam_eval_v1. tie to quality alerts.

Kim: Timeline: copy by Tue EOD, UI changes by Thu, backend by Thu, analytics dashboard ready Fri morning, soft-launch next Mon. OK?

Olivia: Sounds good. Ops-bot: schedule sync Thu 11am to review UI mock and backend PRs.

ops-bot: Reminder set for Thu 11:00. Calendar invite created with Olivia, Ben, Jordan, Priya, Kim, Nate.

Nate: One more ask — add small in-product nudge after 24h for users who started but didn't finish the quickstart. message: "Need help finishing the Prompt Jam? Claim 150 credits when you ship your first prompt."

Olivia: Perfect. Let's keep the experiment window 3 weeks and reconvene at the end with a decision rubric: significance, cost-per-lift, and qualitative feedback. Thanks team :tada:
